rubrics.justification: Description is consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and matches the provided 3AA grading, with appropriate comments on ICM, TE, and zona thinning. Minor overreach includes asserting specific image-visible details like exact ICM location and perivitelline fragments/polar bodies that may not be confidently confirmed.

Integrates age, PCOS, sperm parameters, endometrial thickness, lifestyle, and protocol with embryo quality and prognosis. It misses some nuance around absent AMH data and does not deeply discuss fresh-vs-frozen implications beyond OHSS mention.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, linking morphology, age-related aneuploidy risk, smoking, and endometrium to prognosis. Minor issue: calling the embryo 'perfect' overstates morphology and the implantation estimate may be somewhat compressed given the stated smoking effect.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading, SET preference for a good-quality day-5 blastocyst, smoking cessation, and consideration of OHSS risk in PCOS. Slight deviations include somewhat strong endorsement of PGT-A after one failed cycle and broad statement about luteal phase defects in PCOS.

Provides practical recommendations including SET, smoking cessation, luteal support, OHSS monitoring, and future consideration of PGT-A and metabolic screening. Useful and case-relevant, though some recommendations could be more individualized to fresh transfer details and clinic protocol.
